name: hotel-reservation-caliper-benchmarks
description: Hyperledger Caliper benchmarks for hotel reservation blockchain system

scripts.benchmark: npx caliper launch manager --caliper-workspace ./ --caliper-networkconfig networks/fabric-network.yaml --caliper-benchconfig benchmark-config.yaml --caliper-flow-only-test
scripts.benchmark-test: npx caliper launch manager --caliper-workspace ./ --caliper-networkconfig networks/fabric-test-network.yaml --caliper-benchconfig benchmark-test-network.yaml --caliper-flow-only-test
scripts.benchmark-connectivity: npx caliper launch manager --caliper-workspace ./ --caliper-networkconfig networks/fabric-test-network.yaml --caliper-benchconfig benchmark-connectivity.yaml --caliper-flow-only-test
